'''Harjaggo''', also known as '''Harjaggo the Grasping''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who served as a minor [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Harjaggo started a conflict that would become known as the [[Ten-Hour Carnage]] when he stole an obsidian avian sculpture, accidentally crossing [[Voontara Fa'athra]] and the [[Exchange]], who both sent their enforcers to retrieve the sculpture. The resulting conflict led to the deaths of three hundred enforcers and civilians in a [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] city tower and the loss of the sculpture. Harjaggo extended an apology to Fa'athra by holding a banquet that ended up bankrupting Harjaggo, although his life was spared by Fa'athra.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
